APPLICATIONUNDERSECTION147OFTHECOMPANIESACT,2017FOR
HOLDINGOFANNUALGENERALMEETINGANDLAYINGOFACCOUNTS
THEREIN
Dear Sir,
Please refer to SECP letter No.SMD/PRDD/Comp/(13)2021/06 dated March 22, 2023 with
regards to Holding of Annual General Meeting and laying of Accounts therein for the year ended
June 30, 2022. In the aforementioned letter company was directed in terms of Section147 of the Act
to convene its overdue AGM for the year ended June 30, 2022 by July 28, 2023 and to lay therein
Accounts for the year ended June 30, 2022 for shareholders’consideration.
In this regard, it is apprised that the company has scheduled a Board of Directors meeting on
June 26, 2023, for approval of annual accounts. In order to hold AGM on July 28, 2023, a 21-day
prior notice is required which means that the printing of accounts must be completed on July 06,
2023. However, immediately after the Board meeting scheduled to be held on June 26, 2023, the Eid
holidays will commence, due to which the staff at printing press will not be available for the entire
week. Furthermore, as per the Islamic calendar, the Ashura (9th or 1oth Moharram) shall be observed
on July 27& 28,2023, the date on which the AGM was to be held.Therefore,it would not be possible
for the company to hold its AGM on or before July 28, 2023.
In view of the above-explained religious events, it is requested to kindly grant an extension
for further four days and allow us to convene the Annual General Meeting of the Company for FY
2021-22byAugust01,2023.
